bead.title: native claude cost: include cache-read/write tokens in metered CostUSD
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The metered native claude transport under-counts actual_cash_spend when prompt caching is active. nativeCostUSD (internal/harnesses/claude/native_runner.go:270) computes cost via agentcore.DefaultPricing.EstimateCost(model, u.Input, u.Output) — input+output tokens ONLY. agentcore.TokenUsage (internal/core/agent.go:46) carries CacheRead and CacheWrite token counts, and ModelPricing (internal/core/pricing.go:9-10) carries CacheReadPerM/CacheWritePerM rates, but EstimateCost (internal/core/pricing.go:37) ignores both. So a cached turn is billed too low.

ROOT CAUSE: internal/core/pricing.go:37 EstimateCost(model, inputTokens, outputTokens) has no cache params; nativeCostUSD passes only u.Input/u.Output, dropping u.CacheRead/u.CacheWrite.

PROPOSED FIX: Add a cache-aware method PricingTable.EstimateCostWithCache(model string, input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite int) float64 returning the input+output cost PLUS float64(cacheRead)/1e6*CacheReadPerM + float64(cacheWrite)/1e6*CacheWritePerM, keeping the same unknown-model contract (return -1 for unknown model). Prefer a NEW method (do NOT change EstimateCost's signature — other callers depend on it). Update nativeCostUSD (native_runner.go:270) to call the new method with u.CacheRead/u.CacheWrite, preserving the existing negative=>0 guard.

NON-SCOPE: do NOT change the subprocess-path cost (it gets total_cost_usd from the CLI). Do NOT change existing EstimateCost callers. Do NOT flip the default transport.
bead.acceptance:
1. New Test TestEstimateCostWithCache (internal/core/pricing_test.go): for a model whose ModelPricing has CacheReadPerM/CacheWritePerM set, EstimateCostWithCache adds cache cost on top of input+output; an unknown model returns -1.
2. New Test TestNativeRunner_CacheCost (internal/harnesses/claude/native_test.go): a native turn whose TokenUsage includes CacheRead+CacheWrite yields a final CostUSD equal to the cache-inclusive cost (strictly greater than the input+output-only figure).
3. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/core/... ./internal/harnesses/claude/... -count=1 -timeout 120s is green. Do NOT run `go test ./...` (HANGS ~600s on pre-existing live-network ListModels tests — targeted paths only).
4. lefthook run pre-commit passes (fizeau hook = gofmt-check + go vet).
